items.summary: Recommendation: approve no new spend, monetization claims, or implementation admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all under aggregate tracking ID "other". Site-attributed revenue is $0; the $4.92 must remain unattributed. Revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift are not supportable.

AI spend is known only for 4 instrumented sites on 2026-10-01: 16 calls and $2.2785467 total, with 68,333 output tokens and 1,765,735 cache-read input tokens. This is not fleet-wide AI spend. Infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, and other direct costs are absent, so contribution margin and cost-to-learn cannot be calculated. Minimum measurement: a dated cost ledger keyed to site, experiment/change request, and reporting window, including AI, infrastructure, domains, and attributable revenue.

Push back on vanity metrics: impressions, clicks, sessions, ordered items, proposal counts, shipped outputs, and opportunity scores do not establish revenue or profitability without attributable commission, direct cost, and causal measurement. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only as the next eligible test after capacity and overlap clearance; its baseline is 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Do not assign the aggregate $4.92 or forecast upside.
